name: RTX PRO 2000 Blackwell Ollama: gpt-oss:20b eval rate
methodology: Ollama on one RTX PRO 2000 Blackwell 16 GB. Ollama version not printed on this page (the sibling PRO 6000 page is 0.13.5; this one is not asserted to match).
